title: Hinomori Shizuku — A Blissful Moment With You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More

rows.Line: Vineyard

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, these grapes have a rich color to them. They must be good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mm. Yeah, they are.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to find the most delicious grapes I can. Especially if it means seeing Shii smile more like that.)
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho, over here! I found Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you doing over here at the edge of the vineyard?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's because I wanted to find you the very best grapes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Look, I found these right here.
Don't they look delicious? I hope you'll try them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thanks.
But before we eat, do you know where Tsukasa went?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We've been looking for you and Tsukasa to show you two the grapes we picked!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Check these out! I got some shiny white grapes! See how plump and springy they look?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plump and springy? Sounds like you're describing shrimp...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. But I understand what she means.
They do look shiny, plump and springy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We need to show them to Tsukasa.
But where could he be...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He also said that he's going to find the best grapes in the vineyard, so he may still be looking...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Heeeeeeey!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?
se_run_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I did it! I found this vineyard's number-one grapes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: N-Number-one grapes...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you all think?! See how rich and dark this skin is?! There aren't many grapes on this bunch, but each one is massive!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Come to think of it, they did mention how more grapes doesn't necessarily mean more flavor.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, the growers explained that to us before we began.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, Tsukasa, we also believe that we've found this vineyard's number-one grapes. Right, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Your number-one grapes don't stand a chance against ours, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, then let's see them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, your grapes also look excellent.
I'm having trouble ranking them just based on their appearance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, that leaves us with one choice. Why don't we see how they taste?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Finally!
Can I have one of yours, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, of course! Take as many as you like!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's also trade, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay. You can also have as many as you like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mmmmmmmm! So gooooood!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was actually still pretty full, but I've definitely got room in my stomach for these...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like another one?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Sure... Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
I just thought of a decadent way to have these grapes!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Decadent?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! Take one, two, three of these number-one grapes and... Down the hatch!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you're having three at once?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! You're having three of these amazing grapes all at once?! That's super decadent!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm amazed you got them to fit into your mouth.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Under normal circumstances, I wouldn't do anything like this since we'd immediately run out of grapes. Fortunately, we can have as much as we like right now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You three should also try this!
But not so many that you end up drowning in the grape juice!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, I'll try having two♪
Down the hatch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mmm! Mmm, mm-mm!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think she's trying to say, “Wow, I'm swimming in grape juice!”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, I'd like to try doing that as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm not sure about three, so I'll also try two at once... Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is incredible...! My mouth immediately became filled with grape juice! It felt like I was drinking some from a bottle!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know exactly what you mean!
My mouth became so full that I had trouble drinking it all!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it really felt like I was swimming in grape juice!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, Shii, would you also like to give it a try?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Why don't you have a mix of red and white grapes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, that does sound good.
Can I have one of yours, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! You're going to blend them in your mouth?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nice idea, Shizuku!
I'll try doing that as well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, why don't we all see how well they mix together?
